intake.how: getJiraIssue(parent) + searchJiraIssuesUsingJql('parent=<KEY>'); extract key from URL last segment
intake.when: user names a parent issue key/URL — its children become the candidate tasks (else: free-text goal)

knowledge.when: domain terms, business policy, code/status values — verify before assuming

tacit.when: edge cases, past incidents, coupling/danger zones for the area being changed

_note_plan: There is no 'plan' role in dev-loop — step 2 is fixed to the bundled wiki-plan skill (grounded in wiki/). Do not add a plan role here; it is ignored.

verify.how: run the project's test/build/lint/typecheck/QA command; report failures verbatim
verify.when: step 5 — running tests. Execution only; do NOT use a tool that runs its own fix loop

explore.when: step 1 before opening source, and orchestrate Phase 2 leads — only after scripts/graph-freshness.sh printed fresh; a hit is a lead to confirm by search

design.when: issue has a Figma link AND the change touches UI; skip for backend-only tasks

inspect.how: investigate_feature prompt -> list_browser_targets -> capture_browser_scenario -> inspect_web_network_capture; analyze_web_bundle | analyze_javascript_application only under a licence row that allows static analysis of the shipped code; copy each result's confidence + limitations into the row's Unknown cell
inspect.when: Phase A3 reference study, called only by the fresh-context study agent when the requester names an existing product as the reference; workers get inspect=default; the verify_reconstruction prompt stays unused — comparison is the oracle test. Set this entry ONLY when you registered the MCP yourself (claude mcp add --scope local rea -- npx -y rea-agents@<x.y.z> mcp, e.g. for a Ghidra engine env); unset, scripts/reference-study.sh starts the pinned rea-agents for the study session and nothing is registered

_note_workspace: Not a capability role: the parent directories whose git repos /dev-loop:graph-setup onboards and hooks/graph-nudge.sh watches (issue #203). Read with resolve-tools.sh --role workspace.
